text:
monica: Heads up - starting Apr 1 I'll be working Tue/Thu from Boston and the rest from my CA home. It's temporary for Apr-May. Do I need to do a homebase change or anything for the $100 WFH stipend and state tax?

lee (people-ops): Short version: please submit the Homebase Change form with effective date 2026-04-01 and note the days split. We typically prorate the monthly stipend by days in each homebase and payroll will split withholding for the pay period that includes the change.

monica: Is the prorate automatic? Who approves exceptions?

payroll-bot: Auto-prorate enabled if form submitted before payroll cutoff. Exceptions require people-ops approval recorded in the form. Cutoff for Apr 15 pay is 2026-04-05 11:59pm ET.

rita (benefits): Temporary splits usually don't affect benefits eligibility. Only change your benefits address if you permanently relocate; that can trigger carrier rules.

lee (people-ops): If total days in MA exceed 30 in a quarter we may need to evaluate tax nexus and payroll registration. For a two-month temporary split we usually don't register unless >90 days.

monica: Thanks — I'll submit the form and request to keep full stipend for April in the notes (expenses unchanged).

lee (people-ops): Noted. We'll review and confirm once payroll processes.
